thesis: Mohnish Pabrai moved from California to Austin, Texas, primarily due to repeated wildfire evacuations and the desire to optimize his state income tax liability, as California taxes long-term gains at rates comparable to ordinary income while Texas offers zero state income tax. He subsequently sold his Austin home for a price more than three times his purchase price after a Connecticut couple, who saw a Wall Street Journal feature on his library, offered to buy it.
